errata.claim: old 100U exposure root cause (dataset x policy mismatch, no severe vertical rows in first 100U exposure)
errata.corrected_root_cause: ProductionPipelineFactory.pipeline_for_lease() passes mirror_policy to the parent WebDatasetPipeline, but WebDatasetPipeline._with_local_shards() (the persistent-worker clone boundary) omitted mirror_policy; every spawned worker ran with the __init__ default mirror_policy=None, so the worker-side eligibility gate never fired and eligible/selected/applied were all 0 regardless of the actual severe population.

errata.claim: monitoring session death (~U118122, 03:24 local, liangshen maxTokens=1024 reasoning-only) could explain failure to enforce the early-activity gate
errata.explanation: The gate target was U118103 (cumulative mirror_applied > 0 before 118103). The live session observed mirror_eligible == 0 through and past U118103 and did not stop the run; it died ~19 updates after the gate point. The death does not explain, mitigate, or relocate the failure.

errata.correct_phrasing: effective_batch=400 is the rank-0 telemetry cohort (metrics.jsonl aggregate), not a global batch of 80000; ratios such as 2221/40000 = 5.5525% are descriptive statistics over the rank-0 cohort, not global rates
errata.impact_on_verdicts: none (all gates are cohort-internal conservation laws)

root_cause.defect: clone constructor call copied spatial_policy/camera_policy/transparent_policy but omitted mirror_policy; clone fell back to __init__ default mirror_policy=None; worker-side gate `if self.mirror_policy is not None and self.mirror_policy.enabled` never fired
